arguments.command:
@'
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/click/shell_completion.py')
original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:src/click/shell_completion.py'])
current = p.read_bytes()
old_lines = original.splitlines(keepends=True)
import difflib
new_lines = current.splitlines(keepends=True)
matcher = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, [x.rstrip(b'\r\n') for x in old_lines], [x.rstrip(b'\r\n') for x in new_lines], autojunk=False)
result = []
for tag, i, j, a, b in matcher.get_opcodes():
    result.extend(old_lines[i:j] if tag == 'equal' else new_lines[a:b])
p.write_bytes(b''.join(result))
'@ | python -; git --no-pager diff --check && git --no-pager diff --stat
